All three test prices now work correctly. The changes I made are:

1. **`src/money.js`** - `parseEuros()`: Changed from `Number(Number(s.replace(/,/g, '')).toFixed(2)) * 100` to `Math.round(Number(s.replace(/,/g, '')) * 100)`
2. **`src/money.js`** - `cellCents()`: Changed from `Number(s) * 100` to `Math.round(Number(s) * 100)`  
3. **`src/locale.js`** - `decimalCommaToCents()`: Changed from `parseFloat(...) * 100` to `Math.round(parseFloat(...) * 100)`

The root cause was floating-point precision: 39.95 × 100 produces `3995.0000000000005` instead of exactly `3995`. Using `Math.round()` ensures whole cents.
